claim_boundary: A positive Chicago Fed National Activity Index reading denotes above-trend U.S. economic activity, but the composite is revised, mixes 85 indicators and can reflect conditions already represented by closed macro families. Exactly one future preregistered long-or-cash audit may test whether the conservatively delayed zero-threshold state has matched-capital BTC value; no causal or alpha claim is imported from the sources.

primary_sources.identity: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago CFNAI current data
primary_sources.evidence: The CFNAI is a monthly index of overall economic activity; zero corresponds to historical trend growth, negative to below-average growth and positive to above-average growth. It is normally released toward month-end.
primary_sources.boundary: The official interpretation defines the zero threshold but does not establish Bitcoin timing value.

primary_sources.identity: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago introduction to CFNAI
primary_sources.evidence: The index is a principal-components weighted average of 85 activity indicators across production/income, labor, consumption/housing and sales/orders/inventories.
primary_sources.boundary: The same source states that revisions arise from input revisions and estimates of previously unavailable data.

primary_sources.identity: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED, Chicago Fed National Activity Index [CFNAI]
primary_sources.evidence: FRED exposes the monthly Chicago Fed series and documents its units, frequency, source and zero-threshold interpretation.
primary_sources.boundary: FRED is present-vintage and marks the series copyrighted with citation required; internal reproducibility does not claim redistribution rights.

adversarial_prior: Above-trend U.S. activity can coincide with tighter monetary policy and higher discount rates rather than stronger Bitcoin returns.
A broad composite can duplicate closed industrial-production, labor, income, retail, housing and financial-condition signals without independent value.
Present-vintage revisions and estimated missing inputs weaken historical point-in-time fidelity.
A monthly zero-threshold filter may remain in cash during much of a secular BTC advance and still fail to avoid rapid drawdowns.
prohibited_rescue: Do not add CFNAI-MA3, diffusion or component indices, GDP, labor, retail, housing, rates, equities, BTC trend, volatility or on-chain inputs.
Do not replace the official zero threshold, change the 60-day availability floor, smooth, invert, resize, short or leverage after source or outcome access.
Do not reinterpret closed U.S.-macro or financial-condition families as support for this one.

independence.distinct_from_closed_single_series_macro: The decision input is one precomputed 85-indicator common component at its official zero boundary rather than growth in one industrial, labor, income, retail or housing series.
independence.distinct_from_closed_financial_condition: The input measures real economic activity rather than money, credit, equity-market or banking-system financial conditions.
independence.residual_overlap_risk: Because its inputs include already studied macro domains, incremental value over closed families remains MISSING_PROOF and cannot be rescued with components.

missing_proof: No exact 2018-2024 FRED response, monthly lattice, finite-value audit, revision boundary or conservative 60-day mapping has been sealed.
